column_description: Unique identifier for each environmental data entry.
ID of the pose estimation. may be NULL.
Temperature of the environment. may be NULL.
Humidity of the environment. may be NULL.
Lighting of the environment. may be NULL.
Type of the environment (e.g., indoor, outdoor). always exactly one of 'indoor', 'outdoor'. may be NULL.
Detailed description of the environment. may be NULL.
Additional conditions of the environment (e.g., weather, noise level). always exactly one of 'weather', 'noise level'. may be NULL.
